name: Potentially Suspicious Child Process Of ClickOnce Application
description: Detects potentially suspicious child processes of a ClickOnce deployment application
author: GAI_CTI
query: process.parent.executable:*\\AppData\\Local\\Apps\\2.0\\* AND (process.executable:(*\\calc.exe OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\explorer.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\net.exe OR *\\net1.exe OR *\\nltest.exe OR *\\notepad.exe OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\reg.exe OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\schtasks.exe OR *\\werfault.exe OR *\\wscript.exe))
